name: Litematica EasyPlaceFixPlus
description: Fixes wrong block placement in Litematica's Easy Place and extends it — no cheat options. Blocks land exactly as the schematic drew them: slabs, stairs, logs, rails, double chests, levers. What would land wrong is skipped; what placing alone can't finish is done with one click of a tool you carry. Litematica does the placing — this mod only corrects the click.
